name: Local Godot
description: Check and export Godot 4 projects to the web with Godot on this Mac. No account or credits.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Inspect local Godot and web export template readiness and recorded jobs.

tools.name: check
tools.description: Import this Godot project headless, load every GDScript and boot the main scene for 120 frames. Returns parse, script and runtime errors per step. Run after editing scenes or scripts.

tools.name: export
tools.description: Export this Godot project to the web (single-threaded build) and deliver index.html with its .js, .wasm and .pck. Uses the Web preset in export_presets.cfg, creating one when absent. Returns the delivered paths; preview the returned index.html.

preset.description: Optional name of an existing Web export preset. Omit to use the first Web preset.

tools.name: retrieve
tools.description: Retrieve an existing local Godot job without repeating it.

skills.name: local-godot
skills.text: For a Godot 4 project (project.godot at the game root), Local Godot runs the pinned Godot 4.7.2 on this Mac. Inspect godot__status first; the user installs Godot and its web export templates from plugin setup. After editing .gd, .tscn or project.godot call godot__check and fix every reported error before continuing. To play the game in the preview call godot__export, then open the returned web/index.html. Exports are single-threaded and need no cross-origin isolation headers. Jobs run on a copy of the project: dotfiles (including .godot/), node_modules, agent files and keys are not copied and nothing the job changes is written back; only the exported files are delivered. Keep the project under 20000 files and 512 MiB. Prefer the Compatibility renderer (rendering/renderer/rendering_method="gl_compatibility"), which the web export supports best. C# projects cannot be exported to the web.

actions.name: install
actions.label: Download Godot 4.7.2
actions.confirmation: Download the pinned Godot 4.7.2 editor (about 171 MB) into this plugin’s storage. Studio verifies its digest. Existing Godot installations stay unchanged.

actions.name: install-templates
actions.label: Download web export templates
actions.confirmation: Download the pinned Godot 4.7.2 export templates (about 1.3 GB) and keep only the web templates (about 20 MB). Studio verifies the digest and removes the full archive afterwards.
